subject: session: restrict pessimistic-auto-commit to INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE only (#63065)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent with focus on session txn-mode selection and its planner/executor blast radius. `PrepareTxnCtx(ctx, stmt)` is made statement-aware and restricts pessimistic-auto-commit to `INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE` (including `EXPLAIN`/`EXECUTE` unwrapping) while keeping retries forced pessimistic; call sites and `Session` interface are updated consistently. Checked downstream use of `TxnCtx.IsPessimistic` and `PessimisticLockEligible` in planner/executor paths relevant to DML locking behavior and found no remaining Blocker/High issues; later upstream history does not leave an unresolved correctness regression attributable to this change.
